svg.aria-label: CodeFang — Coding agent · terminal. A terminal coding agent that can't touch the disk without consent. Edits are staged in memory, and you approve them from a unified diff in the terminal or over Telegram. Every path is jailed to the workspace, with .env, .git and node_modules blocked. Built with TypeScript, Bun, Vercel AI SDK, Telegraf, Zod. $ codefang · edits staged in memory, not on disk · review the unified diff · ? approve changes (y/N) · ✓ 163 Bun tests
